items.name: Copycat
items.description: Fires an invisible, silent beam as a ranged touch attach. If the target struck is a small, medium, or large humanoid, the wand immediately casts disguise self on the wielder with no use-magic-device check and attempts to disguise them perfectly as the target. This upgrades the Disguise-Self bonus from +10 to +15.

items.name: Potion of Jump
items.description: The subject gets a +10 enhancement bonus on Acrobatics checks made to attempt high jumps or long jumps. The enhancement bonus increases to +20 at caster level 5th, and to +30 (the maximum) at caster level 9th.

items.name: Torch
items.description:
Price 1 cp; Weight 1 lb.

A torch burns for 1 hour, shedding normal light in a 20-foot radius and increasing the light level by one step for an additional 20 feet beyond that area (darkness becomes dim light and dim light becomes normal light). A torch does not increase the light level in normal light or bright light. If a torch is used in combat, treat it as a one-handed improvised weapon that deals bludgeoning damage equal to that of a gauntlet of its size, plus 1 point of fire damage.

items.name: Cloak of Resistance +1
items.description: This garment offers magic protection in the form of a +1 to +5 resistance bonus on all saving throws (Fortitude, Reflex, and Will).
